text:
alex: Draft idea: add a 'rapid fallback' single-row control in the rollout header. One-click apply for common fallback modes (soft-throttle, quarantine, fallback-model). Aim: <20s operator flow, visible audit. Thoughts? :zap:
tess: Love the single-row. Must show which route+rollout it's scoped to and top matched signals. Quick copy: 'Applies to /v1/generate (rollout-88)'.
omar: Agree. Controls: Mode dropdown, Duration presets (15s/60s/5m), Severity toggle, Suppress-notify checkbox. Show estimated cost/latency deltas inline.
alex: I'll include estimated badges (cost: +x%, p99: +y ms) and a small 'matched signals' pill list. Also a required short justification when severity escalates.
reena: Auditability: each apply needs deterministic breadcrumb id for replay (format: rapid:<yyyyMMdd>T<hhmmss>:<rollout-id>) and a snapshot token for the matched telemetry (eg tb-20260322-01). No random uuid.
cli-bot: Preview: https://console-preview.internal/rapid-fallback?pr=1688 (simulated signals).
tess: Undo policy: allow revert within 2 minutes and record revert reason. Rate-limit applies to avoid oscillation (max 2 applies per rollout per 10m). Show guard tooltip.
omar: Backend contract: log event with actor, rollout, route, mode, severity, duration, reason, breadcrumb, snapshot. Example: ```{"event":"rapid_apply","actor":"alex","rollout":"rollout-88","route":"/v1/generate","mode":"quarantine","severity":"high","duration":"60s","reason":"5xx spike us-east","breadcrumb":"rapid:20260322T150000:rollout-88","snapshot":"tb-20260322-01"}```
reena: UI should surface human text too: 'Applied quarantine to /v1/generate (60s) — reason: 5xx spike — view sample traces'. Also an option to attach tiny repro prompt set when prompt-related signals match.
alex: Nice. I'll write a short RFC with mock, telemetry contract, example payload, undo/rate-limit rules, and permission checks. Thanks all :thumbsup:
